conservation_status.note_en: The species-level global category checked for this review is Near Threatened; regional and legal categories may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 本次复核确认的物种级全球等级为近危；地区等级和法律地位可能不同。

description.en: Gila Monster (Heloderma suspectum) is a carnivore reptile associated with desert habitat. It belongs to Helodermatidae; this reviewed summary separates accepted identity and global conservation category from regional claims.
description.zh: 毒蜥（Heloderma suspectum）是与沙漠生境相关的肉食性爬行动物，属于毒蜥科。本次复核把接受的物种身份和全球保护等级与地区性说法区分开。

anatomy.en: Gila Monster is placed in genus Heloderma, family Helodermatidae. Appearance can vary with age, sex, season and locality, so species-level identification should combine several visible characters, location and the accepted scientific name.
anatomy.zh: 毒蜥归入毒蜥属、毒蜥科。外形会随年龄、性别、季节和地点变化，因此物种级鉴定应结合多个可见特征、地点和接受学名。

ecology_and_behavior.en: This project classifies the species as carnivore in desert habitat. Feeding, activity and social behavior can vary among populations and seasons; details should be tied to an exact-taxon account rather than generalized from one observation.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 本项目把该物种归为沙漠生境中的肉食性动物。取食、活动和社会行为会随种群与季节变化；细节应对应精确分类单元资料，不能从一次观察泛化。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Deserts and dry scrublands of southwestern North America The existing map is retained for orientation and is explicitly treated as approximate rather than a verified legal or survey boundary.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 北美洲西南部的沙漠和干燥灌木丛 现有地图仅为定位参考，并明确作为近似示意，而不是经过核实的法律或调查边界。

habitat.text_en: Deserts and dry scrublands of southwestern North America
habitat.text_zh: 北美洲西南部的沙漠和干燥灌木丛

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center and zoom are retained byte-for-byte. Exact-taxon range sources were checked, but no reusable authoritative polygon was established; the point is explicitly labelled as a representative location, not the full range.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点和缩放级别逐字节保留。已检查精确分类单元的分布来源，但未取得可复用的权威多边形；页面明确把该点标为代表性地点，而非完整分布范围。

range.authority: GBIF species occurrence and distribution record

content_review.notes: legacy-qc-batch-05. GBIF exact identity and global category checked; bilingual templates compared line by line; previous map geometry retained byte-for-byte.

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Development and reproduction depend strongly on temperature and local conditions. Egg laying or live birth, clutch size and maturity differ among species and are not inferred from the reptile label alone.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 发育和繁殖强烈受温度及当地条件影响。卵生或胎生、窝卵数和成熟时间因物种而异，不能只凭爬行动物标签推断。

detail.en: Its body plan is evaluated within Helodermatidae; age, sex and seasonal variation must be separated from species-level traits.
detail.zh: 其身体结构按毒蜥科背景评估；年龄、性别和季节变化必须与物种级特征区分。

detail.en: The carnivore category is a broad guide; exact foods and methods can vary by life stage, season and locality.
detail.zh: 肉食性类别只是宽泛指引；具体食物和方式会随生活阶段、季节及地点变化。

detail.en: Use of desert habitat is interpreted from exact-taxon occurrence and range evidence, not from map shape alone.
detail.zh: 对沙漠生境的利用依据精确分类单元的出现与分布证据解释，不能只看地图形状。

ecological_role.en: As a carnivore species in desert habitat, it transfers energy through local food webs. Its exact ecological effect depends on abundance, food resources and interactions documented for each population.
ecological_role.zh: 作为沙漠生境中的肉食性物种，它在当地食物网中传递能量。具体生态影响取决于各地种群数量、食物资源和有记录的相互作用。

threats.en: The Near Threatened global category does not remove local risks from habitat change, direct mortality, disturbance, pollution or climate effects.
threats.zh: 近危这一全球等级并不排除生境变化、直接死亡、干扰、污染或气候影响等地方风险。

actions.en: Protect the habitats and ecological processes identified by range authorities, reduce documented direct mortality and update management when monitoring or taxonomy changes.
actions.zh: 应保护分布权威确认的生境和生态过程，减少有记录的直接死亡，并在监测或分类变化时更新管理。

key_features.en: Confirm Gila Monster with multiple visible characters, location and an exact taxon-linked record; color or body shape alone may be insufficient.
key_features.zh: 确认毒蜥时，应结合多个可见特征、地点和精确分类单元记录；仅凭颜色或体形可能不足。

similar_species.en: Close relatives and regional look-alikes can share major features. A filename, common name or single trait is not enough for image approval.
similar_species.zh: 近缘种和地区性相似种可能共享主要特征。文件名、俗名或单一特征不足以批准图片。

communication_and_senses.en: Communication and sensory channels are shaped by this species' habitat and class. A specific call, scent signal or sensory claim should be assigned only when the exact-taxon source supports it.
communication_and_senses.zh: 交流与感官通道受该物种生境和类群塑造。只有精确分类单元来源支持时，才能指定具体叫声、气味信号或感官能力。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding, movement, molt, dormancy or food use can shift with latitude, rainfall, temperature and resource pulses. A date from one population is not treated as universal.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖、移动、换羽、休眠或食物利用会随纬度、降雨、温度和资源脉冲变化。某一种群的日期不会被写成普遍规律。

relationship_with_humans.en: Use, conflict, tourism and cultural relationships vary across the range. Safe observation avoids handling, feeding, playback and disturbance of nests, dens or natural behavior.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 利用、冲突、旅游和文化关系因分布区而异。安全观察应避免触摸、投喂、播放声音，以及干扰巢穴、洞穴或自然行为。

evolution.en: Heloderma suspectum is placed in genus Heloderma, family Helodermatidae, order Squamata. This review follows the accepted species match cited in the taxonomy evidence.
evolution.zh: Heloderma suspectum归入毒蜥属、毒蜥科、有鳞目。本次复核遵循分类证据中的接受种匹配。

field_signs.en: Tracks, calls, nests, feeding marks, molts or other indirect signs can narrow an identification but usually cannot confirm a species alone. Sensitive or dangerous animals require distance.
field_signs.zh: 足迹、叫声、巢、取食痕迹、蜕皮或其他间接线索可缩小鉴定范围，但通常不能单独确认物种。遇到敏感或危险动物应保持距离。

text.en: The accepted scientific name used in this review is Heloderma suspectum.
text.zh: 本次复核采用的接受学名是Heloderma suspectum。

text.en: Near Threatened is the checked global IUCN category, not a regional legal status.
text.zh: 近危是本次核对的全球IUCN等级，并非地区性法律地位。

text.en: The map retains a representative point and does not present it as the full range.
text.zh: 地图保留代表点，并不把它当作完整分布范围。

content.en: Development and reproduction depend strongly on temperature and local conditions. Egg laying or live birth, clutch size and maturity differ among species and are not inferred from the reptile label alone.
content.zh: 发育和繁殖强烈受温度及当地条件影响。卵生或胎生、窝卵数和成熟时间因物种而异，不能只凭爬行动物标签推断。
